reasoning: A wins. Both attempts keep the four functions' behavior unchanged and refactor them well, and both leave the same bare return in getTallest. B is slightly richer in helpers, but it breaks the task's rule to change only PlotStats.luau: it commits a .tmpcheck folder of scratch files, and those files fail luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua. B's types are also weaker, with Position declared as required and checked only through an any cast. A changes only the target file, passes every check, and has honest types, so it is the one a developer would merge.
